newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown pressed to raise taxes - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown pressed to raise taxes - paper.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is under intense pressure to raise taxes significantly in his budget on Wednesday, the Times newspaper said on Monday.
It said a tax increase would help to take the steam out of consumer spending and avert the threat of a sharp rise in interest rates later this year.
Many economists think the budget should aim to raise up to five billion stg through higher taxes.
